attributes.board_name: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation (Veterinary Licensing and Disciplinary Board)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs given or approved by approved veterinary programs, AVMA and constituents, ISVMA or other state/provincial VMAs, AAHA, AAVSB RACE, veterinary specialty organizations, USDA (incl. USDA Recertification Course); self-study from approved providers allowed
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal.
rules.alternatives: Waiver for good cause (military service, incapacitating illness, undue hardship); CE used for another state may count if consistent.
rules.audit_note: Division may require evidence; keep CE records 4 years.
rules.notes: Prerenewal period = 24 months before license expiration. 1 hour = 50-60 min. Sexual harassment prevention training required before each renewal (20 ILCS 2105/2105-15.5; hours set by Department rule). Out-of-state non-approved programs need prior approval ($25).
rules.rule_quote: 1) Each person who applies for renewal of a license as a veterinarian is required to complete 40 hours of continuing education (CE) relevant to the practice of veterinary medicine and surgery during the prerenewal period. 2) A prerenewal period is the 24 months preceding the expiration date of the license.
